title: fix: _Static_assert coupling CBOR DoS guard to MAX_ENTRIES
description: The DoS guard in cbor_skip (line 447: val > WP11_KEYSTORE_MAX_CT_LEN/2) prevents a forged map from claiming more pairs than can physically fit in the buffer. This bound is derived from MAX_ENTRIES: each entry is a CBOR map, and the minimum bytes per pair is 2, so the max pair count is MAX_CT_LEN/2. If MAX_ENTRIES is raised without updating the DoS guard, a malicious file can trigger O(MAX_CT_LEN^2) cbor_skip calls. Fix: add _Static_assert(WP11_KEYSTORE_MAX_ENTRIES * 2u <= WP11_KEYSTORE_MAX_CT_LEN / 2u, "raise CBOR DoS guard if MAX_ENTRIES increases") adjacent to both constants. Add a comment at the guard explaining the derivation.
